Name: Enchanted Hospital and Apothecary
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KiTnDrS.png[/img]﻿[size=3]What is up with all the weird birds? No one really knows but they seem to love the place, they live here since the owner Harvey first arrived, maybe the old hospital is their chosen domain or maybe there is something in there that makes them stay? Well it doesn't matter, sooner or later everyone comes back to pay a visit![size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mIuYqgT.png[/img]Redesigned interior
More mysterious, more enchanted.

Tons of birds, they caw! 
It seems like villagers are ok with our flying employees...

Magic circles
Just stand in the middle and wait for it to regen all stamina, you still have to pay Harvey for summoning you back :P
[img]https://i.imgur.com/49Z1mit.png[/img]
[left]Text and secrets.

Ghosts, night customers?

Feathers everywhere!

Potion shops for day and night.
